{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1]['customer_age'].count()}")

# Check revenue column
print(f"Unique revenue values (first 10): {df['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")

# Check for the QA orders
print(f"Number of rows with revenue == '999999.99': {df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]}")

# Check status
print(f"Unique status values: {df['status'].unique()}")

# Check customer_segment
print(f"Unique customer_segment values: {df['customer_segment'].unique()}")

# Inspect first few rows
print(df.head())"}
